component.name: Nooreldean Super App
component.summary: Personalized fitness training, nutrition plans, gamification, and habit tracking super app

description.p: Nooreldean Super App is a comprehensive fitness and lifestyle coaching application. Features include personalized training (sets/reps/RIR), nutrition planning with scientific solvers, gamification (coins, streaks, leaderboards), habit tracking, and a built-in community hub.
